text:
Iris (CS): Hi all
Starting thread for Zenfold onboarding. Goals from PO: sandbox ready, SSO + KMS, end-to-end chat test + dashboard by day 21. Also want a short enablement for their support team. Who picks what?
Dev (CSM): I can run stakeholder mapping and success criteria. Propose 30-min weekly sync Wednesday 9am PT.
Marta (Zenfold): Hi 12 Marta (product at Zenfold). Our timeline is driven by a marketing launch in 6 weeks. Key risks: legal review on data retention and org SSO rollout.
Omar (Solutions): I'll own the integration. Need sample payloads, expected QPS, and whether they plan to use embeddings.
Leah (Security): I'll take security questionnaire + compliance sign-off. Note: if retention >90d we may need alternate archival plan.
Iris (CS): Owners: Dev -> comms & RACI, Omar -> tech lead, Leah -> security, Iris -> onboarding milestones & renewal watch. Marta -> provide SSO contact + sample traffic.
Marta (Zenfold): SSO contact: idp-admin@zenfold.com. We'll share sample 2-minute convo + QPS estimate (burst to 30) by EOD tomorrow.
Omar (Solutions): Minimal timeline suggestion:
Week 0: Kickoff, collect SSO/KMS/CIDRs, test accounts
Week 1: Sandbox provision + smoke auth + first perf run
Week 2: E2E integration + dashboard seed + runbook draft
Week 3: Enablement, QA sign-off, and launch prep
Iris (CS): Risks: if legal requires data flow changes and review >10 days -> raise renewal risk flag. Also firewall windows may add 48-72h.
Dev (CSM): Draft success criteria: 1) Sandbox reachable & authenticated; 2) E2E test passes with p95 < target latency; 3) Dashboard shows cost/k and latency lines; 4) Support enablement session recorded + playbook delivered.
Marta (Zenfold): We'll pay attention to cost/k. Also want a short feedback loop after week 2 to capture UX notes from QA.
Omar (Solutions): Pre-reqs for deep-dive: SAML/OIDC metadata, sample request/response, CIDR and test creds. Can we schedule 60-min technical deep-dive Fri 1pm PT?
Iris (CS): Works for me. Dev? Leah?
Dev (CSM): Yes. Scheduling weekly cadence and adding renewal checkpoints at 60/30/14 days.
Leah (Security): I'll review the questionnaire before Fri and flag any blockers. Marta, please attach any compliance doc in the shared folder.
runbook-bot: Onboarding runbook created: https://redwood.docs/onboarding/zenfold-draft (edit access: team + zenfold).
Iris (CS): Next steps: 1) Marta uploads artifacts (EOD tomorrow), 2) Omar drafts test plan and perf targets, 3) Leah runs quick pre-check and posts any legal asks. After the Fri deep-dive we'll lock Week 1 tasks. If anything blocks, drop updates here. :rocket:
